result:
Confirmed — this is a clear, explicit claim contradicted by `src/lib/permissions.ts` (`"project:archive": "admin"`, not `"owner"`).

All three discrepancies verified against `src/lib/permissions.ts`'s `ROLE_MATRIX` (the actual enforcement point):

1. **`docs/requirements/comments-and-mentions.md`** — states `comment:create` "carries a `viewer` minimum in `ROLE_MATRIX`," letting a viewer comment without promotion. The code sets `"comment:create": "member"` — viewers cannot create comments.
2. **`docs/requirements/projects.md`** — states `project:archive` "is gated at `owner` in `ROLE_MATRIX` — the same minimum as `project:delete`," specifically to stop admins from archiving. The code sets `"project:archive": "admin"`, so admins can archive projects, contradicting the documented floor.
3. **`docs/ui/screen-settings-billing-flags-webhooks.md`** — states the feature-flags screen's permission is "`org:manage_flags` (member and above) — 404 otherwise." The code sets `"org:manage_flags": "admin"`, so members are actually turned away (404), not admitted.

All other documents referencing these same actions (e.g. `docs/design/permission-model.md`, `docs/requirements/membership-and-roles.md`, `docs/api/actions-comments.md`, `docs/api/actions-projects.md`, `docs/requirements/feature-flags.md`) state the correct minimums and agree with the code.

ANSWER: docs/requirements/comments-and-mentions.md, docs/requirements/projects.md, docs/ui/screen-settings-billing-flags-webhooks.md
